note: Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation (EX-3.1 to the June 2021 8-K, Item 5.03) converting a long-standing public company to a Delaware PBC mid-life; no earlier certificate is provided. Article THIRD pairs default any-lawful-act language with an explicit Subchapter XV election, a balancing-of-interests clause, and a specific public benefit purpose. Exercises Amendment Supermajority Requirements = 'No' despite a real 66 2/3% supermajority: the provision names Articles FIFTH, SEVENTH, EIGHTH, NINTH, TENTH, TWELFTH and THIRTEENTH but not Article THIRD, and the Class B protective provisions only reach Section A of Article FOURTH — a supermajority existing is not the same as it covering the PBC/purpose article. Also a PBC counterpart to First Keystone's non-PBC 'supermajority elsewhere' case. The June 2021 EX-3.2 (bylaws) filed alongside is deliberately not included.
